class Maths:
    count = 0
    def __init__(self):
        Maths.count += 1
    @staticmethod
    def add(a, b): # no self, no cls
        return a + b
    @classmethod
    def total_objects(cls): # gets the class as cls
        return cls.count
Maths(); Maths()
print(Maths.add(2, 3)) # 5
print(Maths.total_objects()) # 2
Note: staticmethod is a plain helper; classmethod works on the class itself.
